rows.label: tlk41700126_03_msg0001
rows.name:
Even a Divine Beast crashing into it
won't budge it... My curiosity about
the World Tree never ends!

rows.label: tlk41700126_03_msg0002
rows.name:
Since it's called the World
Tree, it's also a subject
of botanical study.

rows.label: tlk41700126_03_msg0003
rows.name:
I'd love to take young Ili there for
some fieldwork inside it someday.

rows.label: tlk41700126_03_msg0004
rows.name:
Ili is a kid in this town who
looks after the trees...

rows.label: tlk41700126_03_msg0005
rows.name:
He's got a pretty good eye for
plants, and what's more, he says
his dream is to be a botanist.

rows.label: tlk41700126_03_msg0006
rows.name:
I thought I ought to be someone young
Ili could look to for guidance.
